specs.Item Highlight: Bluetooth 5.0, Soft Breathable Fabric, Long Battery Life, Light & Portable, Deep Peaceful Sleep

features: HIFI SOUND QUALITY: Features Bluetooth 5.0 connectivity and delivers clear, high-fidelity audio to help you enjoy deep and peaceful sleep every night.
ULTRA-THIN & PORTABLE DESIGN: The compact, lightweight pillow speaker is easy to carry and place under or beside your pillow for a comfortable sleep experience.
SKIN-FRIENDLY FABRIC: Covered with soft, breathable, and gentle fabric that is pleasant to touch and comfortable against your skin during sleep.
LONG BATTERY LIFE: Built-in rechargeable battery provides extended playtime, ensuring uninterrupted music or soothing sounds throughout the night.
PERFECT GIFT CHOICE: Ideal for children and adults alike, this pillow speaker makes a thoughtful gift for anyone seeking quiet, undisturbed, and tranquil sleep.
description: Transform your nights with this ultra-thin Bluetooth pillow speaker, designed to deliver soft, soothing sounds that help you drift into a deep and peaceful sleep. Whether you are a restless sleeper, a light sleeper, or simply someone who enjoys falling asleep to calming music or bedtime stories, this pillow speaker is your perfect bedside companion. Featuring Bluetooth 5.0 connectivity, it pairs seamlessly with your devices for a smooth, wireless listening experience. The HiFi sound quality ensures clear, rich audio right beside your ear, without disturbing anyone else in the room. Wrapped in a skin-friendly, soft, and breathable fabric, the speaker is gentle against your face and comfortable to rest on throughout the night. Its light and portable design makes it easy to carry while travelling as well. The long battery life means you can enjoy uninterrupted audio all night long. This pillow speaker also makes a thoughtful and practical gift for loved ones of all ages, including children who enjoy soothing bedtime stories.
